infra.report.title: Report
infra.report.subtitle: AWOG does not write these itself. Each kind opens a session carrying the exact brief, and the agent reads your real data to write the report.
infra.report.noSidecar: The engine is not running, so the report catalogue cannot be read.
infra.report.empty: The catalogue came back empty — the engine returned no report kinds.
infra.report.action.askHint: Opens a session with this report's brief — the agent reads your real data and writes it
infra.report.action.scheduleHint: Creates a recurring session that writes this report. Pressing again edits the same entry
infra.report.kind.costAbout: This month's and last month's spend by service, the three fastest-growing line items with the reason behind each, and the actions worth taking.
infra.report.kind.healthAbout: Availability · error rate · alarms that fired · deployments · open work, compared with the week right before it.
infra.report.kind.activityAbout: The action log: who ran what, how many commands ran automatically versus after an approval, how many were blocked, and the total cost.
infra.report.kind.incidentAbout: Merges the action log · application logs · metric charts into one timeline, with a diagram of the affected request path.
infra.report.gap.monthly: "The 1st of every month" cannot be scheduled yet: recurring schedules only support intervals (7 days max), daily or weekly.
infra.report.gap.onDemand: This report runs on demand — reopen this dialog whenever you need it; there is no schedule.
infra.report.error.kinds: Could not read the report catalogue: {msg}
infra.report.error.noAccount: No LLM account is connected, so a schedule cannot be created yet.
infra.report.publish.title: Export this as a report
infra.report.publish.subtitle: Pick the report kind for what the agent just wrote. The kind decides which Wiki folder the page lands in and the source row of the export.
